cohort: The cohort consisted of patients with a body mass index (BMI) of >=40 kg/m(2) who underwent unscheduled cesarean delivery between 2017 and 2020.
finding: Smoking history and hypertensive disease were associated with an increased risk of postpartum readmission, while perioperative antibiotic prophylaxis with cefazolin and vaginal sterile preparation were associated with a decreased risk in class 3 obese patients undergoing unscheduled cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The study focused on patients undergoing unscheduled cesarean deliveries and identified that cefazolin preoperative prophylaxis and vaginal sterile preparation were associated with a decreased risk of postpartum readmission in this specific mode of delivery.
